highlights: GPT Researcher the first open deep research agent designed for both web and local research on any given task.
The agent produces detailed, factual, and unbiased research reports with citations.
GPT Researcher provides a full suite of customization options to create tailor made and domain specific research agents.

Inspired by the recent Plan-and-Solve and RAG papers, GPT Researcher addresses misinformation, speed, determinism, and reliability by offering stable performance and increased speed through parallelized agent work.
Objective conclusions for manual research can take weeks, requiring vast resources and time.
LLMs trained on outdated information can hallucinate, becoming irrelevant for current research tasks.
Current LLMs have token limitations, insufficient for generating long research reports.
Selective web sources can introduce bias into research tasks.
